The BEST Homemade Boba Smoothie Ever (like Boba Tea but better!) #shorts
Did you know you can make a creamy boba smoothie at home in just 15 minutes? 🧋🍓
Boil some tapioca pearls and mix them with a little brown sugar. Then blend strawberries, a frozen banana, coconut yogurt, almond milk, and a splash of maple syrup. Stir in the sweet tapioca pearls, and voilà—your dreamy bubble tea smoothie is ready to sip!
